name: Tierra del Vino de Zamora

known.article: Tierra del Vino de Zamora DO
known.via: English Wikipedia "Tierra del Vino de Zamora (DO)" (redirects to "Tierra del Vino de Zamora DO")

communes: Cubo De Tierra Del Vino, El

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A DO in southeastern Zamora province, with ten villages in neighboring Salamanca province, in Castile and León. Its rules cover wine from red Tempranillo, Garnacha Tinta and Cabernet Sauvignon, and from whites including Doña Blanca, Muscat Blanc, Verdejo and Godello.
